n: Mormon closes 3 Nephi by delivering a message Jesus commanded him to write to the Gentiles of the last days. He introduces it as the words of Jesus Christ, the Son of the living God.

f.w: the Son of the living God

n: Christ calls the Gentiles to turn from lying, deception, sexual sin, secret evils, idolatry, murder, priestcraft, envy, and strife; to come to him and be baptized for remission of sins; to be filled with the Holy Ghost; and to be counted among Israel. It is a one-verse summary of the gospel invitation.

f.g: Preaching for money or popularity instead of God’s glory.
